title: fix: price Qwen3.8 27B at Chutes cost with Reka fallback
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Updated Qwen3.8 27B pricing per million input, cached-input, and output tokens to match its Chutes FP8 primary route. Replaced the Akash FP8 fallback with Reka FP8; Reka output costs more than the new output price. Paid-only access and model capabilities are unchanged. Primary and forced-fallback checks covered text, streaming, image, video, tools, and cache hits.
